title: Easton realization, GCH, and SCH
deferred_material: Easton's realization theorem for continuum functions on regular cardinals; consistency or independence results about GCH and SCH
supporting_development_needed: Use the existing model-witness criteria, membership semantics and generic-extension theorem as foundations. Develop the precise cardinal-preservation and iteration framework needed for Easton realization, and supply the relevant constructibility/forcing witnesses for GCH or SCH claims. Necessary continuum inequalities and equality of ordinals alone do not establish realization or independence.
